title: fix(lint)!: refuse a page variable `source` naming no component on the page, and a `page.NAME` read the page does not declare
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUmUy7mddyM9KUzene3eqMA)_

Fixes #28725

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a page variable's `source` binding or `page.NAME` reads; both refusals carry their own fix and `os explain` entries.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：页面变量的 `source` 写了页面上不存在的组件 id（如 `no_such_component`），以及组件 `visibleWhen` 读了页面没声明的变量（如 `page.nosuch == 'x'`），现在都被拒：保存、草稿诊断、发布、`os validate` 四处同一条结论，定位到 `variables[i].source` 或该组件。
- **为什么改**：以前这两种都能保存、草稿显示 valid、照常发布。控制台按组件 id 精确匹配写入方，`source` 写错就没有任何组件会写这个变量；`page` 里只有声明过的变量，读没声明的名字永远取不到值，组件就无条件显示。作者毫不知情。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只收紧写入口，已存页面照常加载和服务，只有下次保存才被判。仓内语料 3 个 `source`、5 个 `page.X` 读取（都在 showcase 两个页面），零命中；examples 三个 `os validate` 全过。回滚即撤回 `@objectstack/lint` 这次改动。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts`（`firstUndeclaredPageRead` 与 checkElement 的 3c 段）；`packages/lint/src/validate-page-variables.ts`（`source` 判定）；`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.page-variable-references.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.page-variable-references.test.ts`，预期 17/17 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/lint/src/validate-page-variables.ts`: a fourth id beside #28663's three, `page-variable-source-unknown`. A variable whose `source` names a component `id` the page does not hold is refused, located at `variables[i].source`. The page's component ids come from `walkPageComponents`, the one traversal every page rule shares (regions, slots, and the sub-trees inside `properties`), read once per page and only when some entry has a `source`; no second walk. A source-authored page (`kind: 'react'` / `'html'`) is not judged on `source`: its components live in the code, which that walk deliberately skips.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts`: a new gating id, `visibility-page-variable-undeclared`. On a page component, a `visibleWhen` reading `page.NAME` or `page.?NAME` where the page declares no variable `NAME` is refused, located at the component, naming the first such read. Judged from the AST the `has()` check already holds (formula's `parseCelToAst`, no second parser), with the page's declared names passed into `checkElement` from the pages loop only. The nav walker is untouched (#28726 owns it). Stand-downs are missed catches only: an index read (`page['x']`), and any predicate whose comprehension binds `page` as its loop variable (`COMPREHENSION_MACROS`, reused from `predicate-rhs-position.ts`).
- Why that file and not `validate-predicate-path-refs.ts` (measured, as the order asked): the path rule resolves `data.*` against a metadata type's schema only; nothing in it reads a `page` root. The visibility rule is where `page` is declared as a root (`VIEW_PAGE_EXTRA_ROOTS`) and where the page walk already hands each component's predicate to the parser.
- `packages/lint/src/index.ts`: exports both id constants. `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`: two `os explain` entries.
- No `authoring-rules.ts` change: both ids live inside rules already registered on `page` writes, so save, draft `_diagnostics`, publish and `os validate` carry them with no registry or `metadata-protocol` source change, and the CLI rule count does not move (no `content/docs/**` edit).
- `.changeset/28725-page-variable-source-and-read.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Why

#28663 judged the `variables` list itself; the contract review of PR #28723 (finding S3) left these two references admitted, and this card measured both on a stock showcase: draft `_diagnostics` `valid: true`, publish succeeds. What the console does with each, read at `ui/` on this head:

- **`source`.** `usePageVariableBinding(componentId)` (`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/usePageVariables.tsx`) returns `definitions.find((d) => d.source === componentId)`, and the two writer elements (`element:record_picker`, `element:text_input`) call it with their own `schema.id`. A `source` no component carries matches nothing, so no element writes the variable and it keeps its default. The refusal matches a binding that can never resolve.
- **`page.NAME`.** `buildNodeEvaluationScope` (`ui/packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`) sets `page: pageVariables`, written after the ambient spread, so nothing else can supply `page`. The variables come from `PageVariablesProvider`, mounted by the page renderer only when the page declares variables and seeded from the declarations alone. Its only writers are a bound element (by a declaration's `source`) and the dashboard filter bar (its own declared filters), so an undeclared name is never present. A page with no variables gets the frozen empty fallback. No route params or other bindings reach `page`. The read faults and the element renders, which is the refusal's stated consequence.
- Nesting: a provider merges an outer scope (objectui#2578), documented for a filtered dashboard embedded in a page. That is a dashboard reading the page's variables, not a page component reading another scope's, so it does not reach this rule.

**Migration note.** Shipped corpus (`examples/**`, `packages/*/src`, platform apps): 3 variable `source` bindings and 5 `page.NAME` predicate reads, all on two showcase pages (`page-variables.page.ts`, `contact-form.page.ts`). **0 refused.** `os validate` at head on `examples/app-showcase`, `app-crm`, `app-todo`: `"valid": true`, 0 findings of the new ids. Positive controls on the same command: planting `source: 'project_pickr'` or `visibleWhen: "page.selectedProjectID == ''"` in the showcase page makes `os validate` exit 1 with the new id at the right path. Stored pages keep loading and serving; only the next save of one with a finding is refused.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.page-variable-references.test.ts` (new): the card's `source: "no_such_component"`, a case-mismatched id, the card's `page.nosuch == 'x'`, a `{ dialect, source }` envelope, `page.?nosuch`, and a `page.X` read on a page with no variables, each refused at the page door with its path, with door / `os validate` (`runAuthoringRules('validate')`) parity. Controls admitted at both: the showcase picker shape, a variable with no `source`, a `has()`-guarded declared read, a read through a declared `object` variable, a comprehension binding `page`, no `page` read. Also: a writer nested in a container's `children` resolves; a `kind: 'react'` page is not judged on `source`; two undeclared reads are one finding; both faults are two findings.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`: two new rows in the #26707 table (the draft saves, reads `valid: false` with the publish's words, publish refuses `422 INVALID_METADATA`); the clean controls read `valid: true` and publish; paths are item-relative (`variables.0.source`, `regions.0.components.0`).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: the active `saveMetaItem` refuses each (door message = build message, nothing stored); the clean page lands.
- Fixture triage (declaration added, not respelled): `validate-visibility-predicates.test.ts` and `runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts` each had a clean control reading `page.selectedId` / `page.selectedProjectId` on a page that declared no variables. Each page now declares the variable; the second file's family id set gains the new id, so its controls also assert it stays silent.

## Acceptance notes

- Declaration: the claim's line reads `Clause-②: no`; this body and the changeset carry `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, because `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` beside a line without the `(narrowing)` arm. The order's Declarations section names it a narrowing.
- File surface: the claim names `packages/lint/src/**` and its tests; the two `packages/metadata-protocol` test files above are added for the draft / publish / active-save proof, as #28723 did. Test-only, no source change there.
- Serial with #28726: its PR #28756 (the nav over-budget arm in the same file) landed after this PR opened; this PR merged it and carries the seat-ordered fold of the two `visibility-predicate-over-budget` sentence builders (see "Patch round" below).
- Not judged, by design (missed catches, never false errors): `page['x']` index reads; `{{page.NAME}}` tokens in action bodies (an interpolation surface, not a predicate the visibility rule walks); `page.NAME` in props-bag CEL slots (`page:tabs` item `visibleWhen`, which binds `data` to the row, and the other slots `validatePagePredicateBounds` reads). Whether `source` names a component that can WRITE (only `element:record_picker` and `element:text_input` call the binding) is not judged either; the ruling asks only that the id exist.

## Patch round: over-budget builder fold (seat-ordered deviation)

Ordered by server seat 5 after #28756 (PR for #28726) landed: `checkElement`'s bounds arm and #28756's `navOverBudgetFinding` built the `visibility-predicate-over-budget` sentence in two places. Head `f0519ad0` (after merging origin/main `d08b859a`) folds them into one `overBudgetFinding(refusal, where, path, surface, root)`, the way `syntaxFinding` already works: the `SyntaxSurface` gains `overBudgetHint(root)`, so the element surface keeps its `ROOT.f in [...]` / formula-field remedy (root from the site's layer) and the nav surface keeps its `current_user.positions.exists(...)` remedy. `navOverBudgetFinding` is gone.

- Wording byte-identical: 9 over-budget findings (view section and page component on the runtime layer, a schema-bound form and a page on the metadata layer, a nav group and its child) from `dist/` built off the pre-fold blob and off the fold compare `cmp`-identical (`pm-orders/server/evidence/28725/fold-byte-identity.txt`). The existing pins (#28726's nav tests, the page/view over-budget tests) pass unchanged.
